original: 二十一日戦闘概報 二十一日来襲艦上機戦爆聯合延八三機八乃至十数機ノ編隊ニテ四次ニ亘リ陸海軍飛行場銃爆撃自〇四五五至〇六四五B二四二機乃至四機ニテ上空哨戒銃爆撃在空時間概ネ二時間以上〇五一〇B二四一機飛行場爆撃同二機一一〇〇ヨリ一時間半ニ亘リ上空ヲ廻リ主トシテ偵察 戦果撃墜一 撃破二 被害ナシ
translation: Action summary for the 21st. On the 21st, carrier planes (fighters and bombers combined), 83 sorties in all, in formations of 8 to 10-odd, strafed and bombed the Army and Navy airfields in four waves. From 0455 to 0645, B-24s, 2 to 4 at a time, patrolled overhead, strafing and bombing, for about two hours or more; at 0510 one B-24 bombed the airfield; from 1100, two of them circled overhead for an hour and a half, mainly reconnoitring. Results: one shot down, two damaged. No damage to us.
note: Time is the telegram's origination (機密第二一二二四三番電, 21st 2243), not of any action. Telegram from the Miyako-jima Guard Unit (宮古島警, sender) to Sasebo Naval District and Okinawa Base Force (佐鎮・沖根), info Ishigaki-jima Guard Unit (石垣島警); originator's number 機密第二一二二四三番電 (21st 2243), received 22 Apr 0047, decoded 0530-0720; in the Navy's Nansei Shoto telegram file (電報綴 南西諸島 其の4, part 1, page stamped 0879). CONTEXT ONLY, NOT A MATCH: this is Miyako's report, while ENS Corzine (CHENANGO VF) was hit by AA over Ishigaki airfield in a strike launched 1530 I and ditched ~20 mi east of Ishigaki (US ACA Report 50, NARA 140031168 p248); Miyako's 'one shot down' is some other aircraft or claim. Doubtful readings: 延八三機 (83 sorties) has a contemporary pencil '?' beside 三; '一時間半' has a pencil '?' beside 一; it is not clear from the wording whether 自〇四五五至〇六四五 belongs to the carrier strikes or to the B-24s (read here with the B-24s). No time for the shoot-down is given. Ishigaki-jima's own report for 21 Apr was not found in this file or in part 2 (C19010021300 pp. 1-24).
